items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I played for nearly all the big stars at their homes and things--Basil Rathbone

ctx.x: And as a result of playing in the studios like this, you probably got more jobs playing for what? Parties and things?
Yeah. Used to...I played for nearly all the big stars at their homes and things--Basil Rathbone, Charlie Chaplin, and what was the woman that was...went with Randolph Hearst? Marian Davis, was it?
